build_make_constraint: build constraint jacobians and supporting data for a MuJoCo model and data using make_constraint
create_equality_connect_constraints: create equality connect constraints between two bodies or sites with anchor positions
create_equality_weld_constraints: create equality weld constraints fixing relative position and orientation between two bodies
create_equality_joint_constraints: create equality joint constraints enforcing polynomial relationships between joint positions
create_contact_jacobian: create contact constraint jacobians for collision detection with sparse or dense matrix formats
